reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Howard Marks, co-founder of Oaktree Capital, a leading investment manager.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Howard Marks, co-founder of Oaktree Capital, a leading investment manager, and one of the world’s largest distressed debt investors. In our conversation, we discuss takeaways from the market selloff and rapid recovery in 2020, the importance of assessing both quantitative and qualitative factors in markets. I hope you enjoy this great conversation with Howard Marks.
